title: President & Owner
pitch_angle: Hey Jessica Ellington, Omar here. I know I caught you out of the blue. Saw Boulder Personal Injury Group's recent operations in Boulder and had a quick 20-second question on how your team manages front-office intake spikes?
pain: High-value accident and legal inquiries lost to competing law firms due to delayed intake response

details.offer_name: 24/7 AI Retainer Signer & Case Intake Specialist
details.problem_solved: High-value accident and legal inquiries lost to competing law firms due to delayed intake response
details.core_workflow: Screens potential claimants 24/7, validates liability/injury criteria, signs digital retainer via DocuSign in under 3 minutes
details.implementation_scope: Clio/Filevine CRM integration, DocuSign/HelloSign automated envelope dispatch, high-priority attorney SMS alert
details.roi_observed: Average personal injury case settlement produces $15,000 - $50,000+ in attorney contingency fees
details.roi_estimated: An injured claimant calls 3 firms from Google Ads; the first firm to complete intake signs the retainer 78% of the time
details.roi_assumed: Signing just 1 additional case per quarter yields $25,000+ fee vs $4,000/mo retainer (6x ROI)
details.Call_Script: Hey Jessica Ellington, Omar here. I know I caught you out of the blue. Saw Boulder Personal Injury Group's recent operations in Boulder and had a quick 20-second question on how your team manages front-office intake spikes?
details.First_Question: When someone involved in an auto accident calls your firm at 9 PM on Sunday, who screens the case?
details.Diagnostic_Question: When someone involved in an auto accident calls your firm at 9 PM on Sunday, who screens the case?
Diagnostic_Questions: When someone involved in an auto accident calls your firm at 9 PM on Sunday, who screens the case?
How quickly can your team get an e-retainer in front of a qualified claimant before they call another firm?
What percentage of your Google Ads PPC intake calls go to an answering service that only takes basic notes?
details.Quantification_Question: If you pay $350 per PPC lead and lose one $30,000 contingency case a month to slow intake, what is that costing your firm?
details.Reflection_Script: So if I understand correctly, the issue isn't lead volume — it's that high-value opportunities slip through when your team is occupied. Is that fair?
details.AI_Fit_Transition: We deploy custom AI voice assistants that automate that exact bottleneck so zero inquiries slip through to voicemail. Would you be open to a 2-minute audio simulation showing how it handles a live scenario?
details.CTA_Primary: Would it be helpful if I sent over a 1-page architecture tear-down and audio benchmark to jessica@boulderpersonalinjurygroup.com?
details.CTA_Fallback: No problem at all Jessica Ellington. What's the best email address to send our 1-page operational benchmark report to?

Objection_Playbook.PRICE: I completely understand. Our retainer is $4,000.00/mo with a 30-day performance SLA — recovering just two missed jobs pays for 100% of the cost. If it doesn't, you cancel immediately.
Objection_Playbook.TIMING: Totally respect that you're busy right now. When is a better 5-minute window tomorrow morning to reconnect?
Objection_Playbook.TRUST: Fair point — we don't ask for any trust upfront. We run a 5-minute live diagnostic simulation with your actual test scenarios so you hear it work before deciding.
Objection_Playbook.AI_SKEPTICISM: I hear that a lot because most AI chatbots sound robotic. Ours uses sub-second neural voice trained specifically on your industry's exact terminology and workflow.
Objection_Playbook.ALREADY_HAVE_SOLUTION: That's great you have a system in place. Most operators we work with use this as a 24/7 backup overflow failover so zero calls drop when your team is occupied.
Objection_Playbook.DO_IT_INTERNALLY: Your team's time is best spent closing deals and serving clients, not playing phone tag. The AI handles the repetitive triage at a fraction of human staffing cost.
Objection_Playbook.NO_NEED: Understood. If you ever experience missed calls during peak season, keep us in mind.
Objection_Playbook.NO_BUDGET: If budget is tight, that's even more reason to stop leaking high-value leads. We can start with our diagnostic audit at zero upfront commitment.
Objection_Playbook.AUTHORITY: Got it. Who on your management team handles operational technology and intake software so I can include them?
Objection_Playbook.SECURITY: All our pipelines are SOC-2 and HIPAA compliant with end-to-end encryption. Your client data never trains public models.
Objection_Playbook.INTEGRATION: We connect directly via webhooks to your existing CRM and calendar (ServiceTitan, Clio, Dentrix, Procore, HubSpot) with zero migration hassle.
Objection_Playbook.STAFF: This doesn't replace your staff — it empowers them by handling repetitive triage and 2 AM emergencies so they arrive to work with organized, booked appointments.
